liam: Quick sync — spike notes on window demux + fanout. I'm worried current queue topology assumes 1:1 window->executor. If we allow multiplexing (many windows per exec) how do we enforce headroom and eviction without per-window state explosion?

nina: good call. main tradeoff: per-window metadata (precise deadlines) vs aggregated soft-deadline buckets. per-window gives correctness but memory blowup under high cardinality.

maya: what about a hybrid: keep exact for hot windows, bucket others by latency quantiles and fall back to best-effort eviction? we could promote on repeat hits.

liam: exactly — promotion policy + small LRU hot table. question: eviction signals need to carry 'reason' so downstream can decide graceful degrade vs abort. e.g., "evict:kv-warmup" vs "evict:resource-pressure".

sam: +1, also telemetry: emit "demux.promoted" "demux.evicted.reason=<str>" with window_id tag. means we need cardinality knobs in metrics pipeline, maybe sample by tenant.

nina: implementation sketch:
```
// on enqueue
if (hot_table.contains(win)) assign hot_lane
else assign bucket = latency_bucket(win.expected)

// on pressure
if(hot_lane.headroom < threshold) evict_from_bucket(bucket)
else evict_least_recent(hot_table)
```

maya: need atomicity guarantees across promotion & enqueue or we'll double-count tokens. maybe a CAS on window slot + enqueue-ref must be idempotent.

liam: re: fallback, propose two policies selectable per route: "fallback-to-fastpath" (sacrifice throughput, keep low tail latency) and "fallback-to-bulk" (maximize throughput by batching but inflate p99). default: fastpath for interactive routes.

sam: Routing rules should be plumbed into the admission API. Example oath: `adm.admit(request, route_policy)` can return {decision: admit|hold|evict, annotate: string}. Keep it tiny.

nina: ops-bot: can we add a deploy gate to validate metrics after rollout? @ops-bot add monitor: demux.evictions.rate > 0.5% sustain 5m -> rollback.

ops-bot: monitor created: eng-runtime/demux-eviction-alert (threshold=0.5% 5m). I'll wire a dashboard.

maya: next steps: I'll prototype promotion LRU + sampled telemetry. sam, can you draft admit API proto? liam will write a short runbook for fallback behavior.

liam: works for me. thanks all :thumbsup: I'll push the spike branch and drop link here.
